title: scholar-search MCP tools
description: Stable tool surface. Channel upgrades must not change these schemas.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search a channel for bibliographic records. Read-only. Returns a shortlist by default: abstracts are omitted unless include_abstract is true, and sort_by / min_citations / sources_only filter the parsed records locally without a browser action. Call detail(url) for the full record — after a search it is served from the cache. With channel=webofscience, query may be a Web of Science expression (e.g. TS=(actuator) AND PY=(2021-2026)); when no year range is given the last five years are used, and the span is applied inside the expression rather than through page filters.

site_sort.description: Ask the SITE to re-sort the whole result set: two extra clicks, costs quota (about 5). For ordering the current page only, use `local_sort`, which is free.

source_types.description: Document types to keep. Values are the normalised vocabulary; a channel that does not implement this rejects the request rather than ignoring it.

sources_only.description: Exact source (journal) names to keep, matched case-insensitively.

local_sort.description: Re-order the page already in hand: free, no browser action, no quota (0). Orders only this page, not the whole result set — use `site_sort` for that.

fields.description: Project each record to these keys. `url` is always kept because `detail` needs it. `institution` and `impact_factor` are usually only populated by `detail`, not by a list row — see `status.detail_capabilities`. Unknown keys are rejected rather than silently ignored.

tools.name: detail
tools.description: Fetch full metadata for one record by its detail URL.

tools.name: export
tools.description: Render records as RIS or EndNote text. With `out_path` the text is written to that file and omitted from the response, which is how a large export should be done; without it the text comes back inline.

out_path.description: Write the text here and omit it from the response. Use this for a large export: pulling 143 records through the context just to save them is the expensive way.

include_abstract.description: Keep the abstract in each entry. Off by default: an AB field roughly quadruples an RIS entry, and reference managers fetch abstracts themselves.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Session state: channels, risk cooldown, quota remaining, live bridge readiness.
